mcp__codex_apps__sportlab_sports_hub_historical_threshold
tools.description:
Herramientas privadas de datos deportivos y tendencias históricas. Integración no oficial con SofaScore.

Calculate L5/L10/L20/L30 historical over/under frequency from explicitly mapped observations of ONE exact market, period and settlement. Not a prediction. Filter surface/home/away/opponent before calling. Deduplicates IDs; excludes future and unfinished events; missing observations remain visible.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__sportlab_sports_hub_historical_threshold(args: { as_of: string; direction: "over" | "under"; event_key: string; line: number; rows: Array<{ event_id: number; source: string; start_utc: string; status: string; value: number | null; }>; window: 5 | 10 | 20 | 30; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__sportlab_sports_hub_sports_schedule
tools.description:
Herramientas privadas de datos deportivos y tendencias históricas. Integración no oficial con SofaScore.

Working ESPN sports calendar for MLB, NHL, NFL, NBA, ATP tennis and selected soccer competitions. Source and fetch time explicit. Tennis events can contain nested tournament rounds and matches; do not assume each event is one match. Soccer requires a league. No claim of complete worldwide coverage.

exec tool declaration:
```ts

tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__sportlab_sports_hub_sports_team_history
tools.description:
Herramientas privadas de datos deportivos y tendencias históricas. Integración no oficial con SofaScore.

Read ESPN team season schedule with completed games filtered before cutoff; includes opponents and scores. ESPN team IDs only, not SofaScore IDs. Season year follows ESPN convention (e.g. NHL 2026-27 = 2027). Not available for tennis; missing history is not zero.

```
